HI En - 
The Epson Espression Premium XP-830 you note below would work fine, but it is an 
inkjet, which means the printer is discounted because you'll pay more for ever-
empty ink cartridges over the life of the printer. 
Amazon has it, with an ink multi-pak for $170 https://www.amazon.com/Eassm-
Expression-Premium-Wireless-Multipack/dp/B0 I 79FL1O0/ 
I'd recommend considering the HP LaserJet Pro M277dw Wireless All-in-One Color 
Printer, which is slightly smaller physical size (16.5" x 16.4" x 12.7" vs Epson's 
19.1" x 16.8" x 10.4"), but laser so the toners will last much longer making it 
cheaper to own over the life of the printer. 
Amazon's price is $280 htrns://www.amazon.com HP- L aserJet-N1277ch\ -Wircicss-
Printeddp/B00TV  AC K 
If Jeffrey is buying, I'd order one of each of the high-capacity toner cartridges too, to 
have spares on hand: 
Black - https://www.amazon.com/HP-CF400X-Original-LaserJet-
Cartridge/dp/B00UBMO61G/ 
Cyan - https://www.amazon.com/HP-CF40I X-Original-LaserJet-
Cartridge/dp/B00UBMO7RY/ 
Yellow - https://www.amazon.com/HP-CF402X-Original-LaserJet-
Cartridge/dp/B00UBMO97W/
Magenta - https://www.amazon.com/HP-C F-I03 X-Oriw nal-I ,a serJet-
Cartridge/dp/B00LMMOBN4/ 
Both support AirPrint (printing from iPhone / iPad, etc), but I'd recommend installing the 
drivers from Apple and not from the CD included in the box (those CDs are 
always horribly out of date).

install the relevant driver above and then add the printer via System Preferences > 
Printers. It should see the printer automatically, you'll just need to change the 
driver to use from the AirPrint driver to the installed Apple driver. 
I know that last bit sounds daunting, but it should be obvious at that moment. If you get 
overwhelmed or stuck, I'll have you install an app that allows me to control your 
screen so I can take care of the software side remotely.
